area: Data and test foundation (domain model, seed, persistence, supplier master, inbox, final document, AS-08 open points, E2E harness)
summary:
The prototype's data layer is a set of pure actions over one AppState, saved to localStorage under "bdf-ciq-prototype" with a SCHEMA gate. Today that state is the rich replayed seed: 36 cases, 10 suppliers and 20 fixed supplier users (seed.ts:28, :111-199, :411-419; store.tsx:27-39). The demo needs a different start: no cases, the 11 internal role holders and one fictional supplier (Solvaro Oleochemicals, s1) with 2 contacts. The rich seed stays as a fixture for the tests and for the portal's demo preview.

Gaps the final app needs, in order:
1. **Supplier master.** There is no model or actions for it. Suppliers and contacts are hard-coded, and the supplier personas are fixed to u-sup-1 and u-sup-2 (types.ts:389-402, catalog.ts:431-457, RoleSwitcher.tsx:26-29). New contacts must become switchable personas.
2. **No mail model.** The only notification record is the audit text "Notified supplier" (actions.ts:122, :410).
3. **No final document.** The only trace is an audit line that still names the file after a review version (actions.ts:557-562), which BRM v2 removed.
4. **Open points (AS-08).** They have no edit or history, and decisions are taken at department level instead of by the raiser (OpenPointsPanel.tsx:147-169; reviewResponse actions.ts:439 has no actor check).
5. **Missing guards.** Several actions skip the state guards that the freeze and the release gate depend on. Concrete bugs:
   - A point raised in final-release leaves the case releasable (actions.ts:408 with finalRelease :565-575).
   - supplierRespond can reopen a closed point (actions.ts:415-437).
   - A completed case can be cancelled or have a review reopened (actions.ts:550-555, :577-586).
   - setComponents, setJustification and uploadDocument have no freeze check (actions.ts:250-279).
6. **No E2E harness or test ids.** The prototype has no harness and no data-testid at all.

**Proposal:**
- Split the seed into `buildDemoStart` and `buildScenarioSeed`, move SCHEMA to its own module and bump it to 7, and add a pure persistence module with a `?reset` wipe.
- Add `src/domain/suppliers.ts`, `personas.ts`, `mail.ts`, `finalDocument.ts`, `permissions.ts` and the open-point edit and close actions, all pure and unit-tested.
- Keep new shared-type fields optional, or extend StoreApi into an AppStoreApi, so the live portal (LiveSupplierStore.tsx:265-273, map.ts:411-457) and its harness compile and stay green.
- Add `scripts/harness-prototype.mjs`. It drives the built `dist/` through every role from the empty start, plus fixture-injected edge scenarios, using data-testid and data-status/data-phase attributes, and reads assertions from localStorage.

items.title: Supplier master model (mirrors final-app F1 CIQ Supplier + Contacts)
items.current: types.ts:380-387 Supplier {id,name,duns,country,type,contactIds}. Contacts are plain Users (types.ts:369-378) with no active, may-confirm or history fields. City exists only in seed SUPPLIER_DEFS (seed.ts:67).
items.details:
Supplier gains these fields, all optional so the portal's map.ts:457 literal still compiles:
- `city?: string`
- `active?: boolean`, default true, read through isActive(x) = x.active !== false
- `vendorNo?: string` (SAP vendor id, display only)
- `createdAt?: string`, `createdBy?: string`
- `history?: SupplierEvent[]`, where `SupplierEvent = { at: string; by: string; action: "Created supplier"|"Changed supplier"|"Deactivated supplier"|"Reactivated supplier"|"Added contact"|"Changed contact"|"Deactivated contact"|"Reactivated contact"; detail: string }`

User gains `active?: boolean`, `mayConfirm?: boolean` (default true) and `createdAt?`/`createdBy?`.

This matches app-plan-v4 F1 (docs/kissflow-data-model/app-plan-v4-processes-and-forms.md:208): legal name, DUNS, kind, country, SAP id, active; Contacts with name, e-mail, role, may confirm, active. As in the final app there is no delete anywhere, only deactivation. Cases keep a snapshot of the name, DUNS and e-mails in their answers (actions.ts:98-104), so renaming a supplier or changing its DUNS never rewrites a running or completed CIQ (E-P-84).

items.title: Supplier and contact actions with validation (src/domain/suppliers.ts)
items.current: missing (NewCase.tsx:105-106 only picks from state.suppliers)
items.details:
All functions are pure. Each returns the same state plus a danger toast when validation fails, or `{ state, id }` on success.

Validators, used by both the form and the action:
- `validateSupplier(state, input, editingId?)` returns `{ errors: Partial<Record<'name'|'duns'|'country'|'type'|'contacts', string>>, warnings: string[] }`.
- `validateContact(state, input, editingUserId?)` returns errors for name, email and title.

Rules:
- **Name:** required, trimmed. A duplicate after normalisation (lowercase, punctuation and legal forms GmbH/AG/S.A./Ltd/Inc/S.r.l./Kft./Lda/Sdn Bhd/Co. stripped) is a warning only (E-D-36). The form requires the tick 'Add anyway', and the action takes `ackDuplicateName`.
- **DUNS:** required. Spaces and hyphens are stripped, and the value must then be exactly 9 digits, stored as a string so leading zeros survive (E-D-35). A duplicate DUNS against any supplier, inactive included, is a hard error that names the existing supplier.
- **Country:** required.
- **Type:** manufacturer or distributor.
- **Contacts on add:** at least one.
- **Contact e-mail:** required. Format `^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$`. Unique case-insensitively across ALL users, internal and other suppliers included; the message names the holder. This is a prototype simplification of the final app's one-row-per-supplier rule.
- **Contact name:** required. Title optional, defaulting to 'Supplier contact'. mayConfirm defaults to true.

Actions:
- `addSupplier(s, by, input, at)`: id `s<n>` (max numeric suffix + 1; 's2' in the demo). Creates the contact Users with id `u-<supplierId>-c<k>`, initials, side supplier, supplierId, active. History 'Created supplier' and one 'Added contact' per contact.
- `updateSupplier(s, by, id, patch, at)`: changes only. The history detail lists from→to.
- `setSupplierActive(s, by, id, active, at)`.
- `addContact(s, by, supplierId, input, at)`.
- `updateContact(s, by, userId, patch, at)`.
- `setContactActive(s, by, userId, active, at)`.

Permission: the acting user must hold capability 'supplier.edit' (P-01); otherwise a danger toast and no change.

items.title: Deactivation rules for suppliers and contacts
items.current: missing
items.details:
**Deactivating a contact:**
- Refused if the contact is the last active contact (or the last active mayConfirm contact) on any case that is not closed. The toast names the case and asks to add or assign another contact first (REQ-CTL-003: no task without a person).
- Once deactivated, the contact: is hidden from the role switcher; is excluded from mail recipients and from NewCase contact pickers; cannot act (supplier actions return a danger toast 'This contact is no longer active'); keeps all attribution in answers, audit and the final document.
- If the current persona is deactivated, the store switches to rmm.

**Deactivating a supplier:**
- The supplier is hidden from the NewCase supplier select (selectableSuppliers(state)), and createCase refuses it.
- Open cases continue. The contacts stay active for those open cases.
- It can be reactivated.

Both leave a history entry. There is no delete action at all.

items.title: Who receives what: event → recipient matrix
items.current: Static table only, in EmailPreviews.tsx:11-20. No mail is generated.
items.details:
The actions append mails through `sendMail(state, draft)`, one mail per event per audience.

- **case-invited** (createCase; contacts added in setCaseContacts): the active case contacts, supplier audience, channel task-notification.
- **review-assigned** (confirmCompleteness): each activated track assignee, RMM owner included, one mail each, internal.
- **op-raised** (raiseOpenPoint by a reviewer or by the system for an additional part): the active case contacts, supplier, webhook.
- **op-answered** (supplierRespond, answer or cannot-provide): the raiser only (op.createdBy, or op.responsibleId when createdBy is 'system'), internal, webhook.
- **op-returned** (reviewResponse return): case contacts, supplier, webhook. The body includes the return reason, which the UI already marks 'the supplier sees this' (OpenPointsPanel.tsx:84).
- **op-edited** (editOpenPoint): case contacts, supplier, webhook, with a changed-fields list.
- **op-closed** (accept, not-accepted, withdraw): case contacts, supplier, webhook. Neutral text 'closed by Beiersdorf; no action needed'. The not-accepted reason and the withdraw reason are never included.
- **release-requested** (the last completeReview): case contacts, exactly one per request (REQ-PROC-040), supplier, task-notification.
- **release-withdrawn** (final-release back to review through ensureTracks actions.ts:340-342 or reopenReview :553): case contacts, supplier.
- **case-completed** (finalRelease, then complete): the RMM owner, internal, channel final-document, with documentId = finalDocument.id and the link to /cases/:id/document.
- **release-receipt** (same moment): case contacts, supplier, with no document attached (the final document is internal).
- **case-cancelled** (cancelCase): a neutral supplier mail to case contacts without the reason, and an internal mail to the assignees of non-completed tracks. Individual withdrawn points send no extra mails (E-P-92).
- **case-reactivated**: case contacts, plus internal mail to the track assignees.

Deactivated users are never recipients. A mail with no recipients is not created.

items.title: Supplier-safe composition in one module; every mail logged on the case
items.current: Notification content is scattered as audit strings (actions.ts:122, :410). EmailPreviews.tsx:46-53 builds previews ad hoc from seeded cases.
items.details:
src/domain/mail.ts holds compose(event, ctx), a pure function with subject and body templates. Examples:
- 'CIQ-2026-0101 · HELIOSOFT 200: please fill in the Cosmetic Ingredient Questionnaire'
- 'CIQ-2026-0101: Beiersdorf has a question on K2.1 › component 2 › CAS number'
- 'CIQ-2026-0101 OP-0101-01: Solvaro Oleochemicals answered your question'
- 'CIQ-2026-0101: please give the final CIQ release'
- 'CIQ-2026-0101 completed: final CIQ document'

**Supplier-audience bodies** use only: material name, case id, the supplier kind label (lib.ts:173-180), the reference label, the question, the supplier-safe justification (lib.ts:182, which blanks finding-based ones), the due date, the return reason, the RMM owner as the Beiersdorf contact, and the portal link.

They never contain: department names, reviewer names other than the RMM owner, internal notes, findings, RMES content, decisions, not-accepted or withdraw reasons, or the cancellation reason (E-D-74).

Each sendMail also writes the case audit entry 'Sent e-mail' with event, recipients and subject (REQ-CTL-010). This replaces the two 'Notified supplier' strings.

items.title: Open point change history (AS-08)
items.current: OpenPoint (types.ts:226-243) has no edit history, closedBy, closedAt or reason. Message.action (types.ts:222) has no 'edited' or 'withdrawn'.
items.details:
OpenPoint gains:
- `history?: OpenPointChange[]` (optional for map.ts), where `interface OpenPointChange { id: string; at: string; by: string; kind: 'edited'|'closed'; changes: { field: 'question'|'justification'|'dueDate'|'ref'|'kind'; from: string; to: string }[]; outcome?: 'accepted'|'not-accepted'|'withdrawn'; reason?: string }`

items.title: Open-point guard bugs that break the release gate
items.current:
1. A point raised while the case is in final-release changes no track (actions.ts:408, `r.status !== 'completed'`), and finalRelease checks only the phase (actions.ts:568), so the supplier can release with an open point.
2. supplierRespond (actions.ts:415-437) never checks op.status, so it can turn a closed or withdrawn point back to in-progress.
3. reviewResponse 'accept' closes an unanswered open point.
4. raiseOpenPoint is possible in supplier-input.
items.details:
raiseOpenPoint is allowed only in phase review and only for a track that exists and is not completed. A completed department reopens its review first (reopenReview), which also withdraws a release request and mails release-withdrawn.

finalRelease additionally refuses while any point is unresolved or any track is not completed (defence in depth). supplierRespond requires status 'open'. Unit test each case.

items.title: Withdrawing an additional-part point; cancel withdraws silently
items.current: cancelCase (actions.ts:580) marks open points withdrawn. Nothing is defined for withdrawing an additional-part point.
items.details:
Withdrawing an 'additional-part' point leaves the section in scope, because the scope only grows (REQ-CFG-008). It removes the supplier task (supplierTasks reads status 'open', selectors.ts:222) and unblocks the track.

Cancellation keeps withdrawing every unresolved point with one neutral case-cancelled mail, with no per-point mails and no withdraw history rows (reason 'case cancelled').

Reactivation does not reopen withdrawn points (CaseActions.tsx:106 already says so).

items.title: E2E harness scripts/harness-prototype.mjs (Playwright, built dist/, no backend)
items.current: missing. Patterns to copy: scripts/harness-portal.mjs:15-17 (playwright-core loaded from the Promotion Management node_modules path), :198-201 (random-port 127.0.0.1 servers), :207-250 (scenario, see, check, shot helpers), :21 (fixtures through vite-node).
items.details:
**Server:** serve dist/ (from npm run build, base '' and HashRouter) with a tiny static node:http server on a random 127.0.0.1 port, with MIME types for js, css, woff, woff2 and webp. Option `--ui http://127.0.0.1:5310` targets the dev server instead.

**Isolation and fixtures:**
- Each scenario gets a fresh browser context: empty localStorage gives the empty start.
- Edge scenarios inject a prepared state with a one-time addInitScript, guarded by sessionStorage so reloads keep the scenario's own changes.
- The states come from `scripts/prototype-fixtures.ts`, run through node_modules/.bin/vite-node: `inReview`, `allButRmm`, `finalRelease`, `completed` and `cancelled`, all built from buildDemoStart through the testkit, with sentinel strings planted in internal notes, findings, the not-accepted reason and the cancellation reason.

**Assertions:**
- UI: getByTestId, plus data-status, data-phase and data-count attributes.
- State: `page.evaluate(() => JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('bdf-ciq-prototype')))` for mail counts, phases, finalDocument and history. The app needs no test hook.

**Role switching:** a helper `as(personaId)` clicks role-switcher, then role-option-<id>, then waits for the landing page.

**Generic questionnaire filler:**
- It iterates `[data-testid^=q-field-]` with data-field-type and data-required.
- Values: text 'Harness value'; email 'qa@solvaro.example'; number '1'; range 0/1; yes/no clicks q-yesno-<id>-no; single takes the first option; multi takes the first chip; file uses setInputFiles with an in-memory 'harness.pdf'.
- It adds a K2.1 row through q-component-add.
- It loops through the blocker list (blocker-item with data-section and data-field), at most 4 passes, until confirm-completeness is enabled.

**Output:** dist-harness-prototype/report.json and <scenario>-<tag>.png, outside dist/ so the build output stays clean.

**CLI:** `node scripts/harness-prototype.mjs [P00 P02 …] [--ui url] [--list] [--viewport WxH] [--screens] [--verify-empty]`. The script fails with a non-zero exit code. package.json gets `"harness:prototype": "node scripts/harness-prototype.mjs"`.

items.title: data-testid conventions
items.current: The prototype has no data-testid outside src/workbench. The only hook is id='field-<FLD>' (FieldRenderer.tsx:176).
items.details:
**Convention:** kebab-case `<area>-<thing>[-<id>]`, with record ids appended verbatim (case-row-CIQ-2026-0101, op-card-OP-0101-01, mail-item-M-0003) and persona ids with ':' replaced by '-'. State goes into data-status, data-phase, data-count, data-read and data-tone attributes, never into the testid. Each testid is unique per page, and lists repeat only with an id suffix.

**Required set by area:**
- **Shell:** role-switcher, role-option-*, nav-<route-slug> (nav-rmm, nav-review, nav-cases, nav-cases-new, nav-suppliers, nav-reports, nav-audit, nav-admin-rules, nav-portal, nav-portal-tasks, nav-portal-help), reset-demo, reset-demo-confirm, mail-*, toast (data-tone), empty-*.
- **Suppliers:** supplier-row-<id>, supplier-add, supplier-name, supplier-duns, supplier-country, supplier-city, supplier-type, supplier-name-ack, contact-name-<i>, contact-email-<i>, contact-title-<i>, contact-may-confirm-<i>, contact-add-row, supplier-save, field-error-<field>, contact-row-<userId> (data-active), contact-deactivate-<userId>, supplier-deactivate.
- **New case:** newcase-material, newcase-inci, newcase-material-no, newcase-supplier, newcase-contact-<userId>, newcase-market-<EU>, newcase-due, newcase-priority, newcase-duplicate-warning, newcase-submit.
- **Case:** case-row-<id> (data-phase), case-header (data-phase), case-tab-<key>, case-cancel, case-cancel-reason, case-cancel-confirm, case-reactivate, case-contacts-edit, final-document-*.
- **Portal:** portal-request-<caseId>, q-section-<sectionId> (data-applicability), q-field-<fieldId> (data-field-type, data-required, data-answered), q-config-<SF>-<value>, q-yesno-<id>-yes and q-yesno-<id>-no, q-upload-<fieldId>, q-component-add, q-justify-<fieldId>, blocker-item, confirm-completeness, confirm-agree, confirm-submit, task-<opId>, answer-<opId>, answer-text, answer-cannot, answer-send, final-release, final-release-agree, final-release-submit.
- **Review:** review-row-<caseId>, ask-supplier-<fieldId|sectionId>, raise-question, raise-due, raise-justification, raise-send, op-card-<opId> (data-status, data-outcome), op-accept-<opId>, op-return-<opId>, op-not-accepted-<opId>, op-edit-<opId>, op-withdraw-<opId>, op-reason, op-confirm, rmes-result-<critId>-<result>, rmes-decision-<SAF|REG>-<approved|rejected>, complete-review, complete-review-confirm, review-blockers (data-count).

proposals:
## 1. Module layout (all pure, unit-tested; nothing under src/workbench is touched)
- `src/domain/schema.ts`
  - Exports `SCHEMA = 7` and `STORAGE_KEY`.
  - It has no imports, so the portal and the call build can import it without pulling in seed data.
- `src/domain/seed.ts`
  - Exports `buildDemoStart()`, `buildSeed` (alias, for compatibility), `SCHEMA` (re-export) and `caseById`.
- `src/domain/fixtures/scenarios.ts`
  - Exports `buildScenarioSeed()`: today's 36 replayed cases.
  - It is imported only by the tests, `scripts/prototype-fixtures.ts` and the portal's `DemoSupplierStore`.
- `src/domain/personas.ts`
  - Exports `INTERNAL_PERSONAS`, `supplierPersona`, `personasOf` and `personaById` (legacy aliases `supplier`/`supplier2` → `sup:u-sup-1`/`sup:u-sup-2`).
- `src/domain/suppliers.ts`
  - Validators plus add/update/activate actions for suppliers and contacts, and `selectableSuppliers`.
- `src/domain/mail.ts`
  - Exports `MAIL_EVENTS` (the matrix), `compose`, `sendMail`, `mailFor`, `unreadCount`, `markMailRead` and `markAllRead`.
- `src/domain/finalDocument.ts`
  - Exports `buildFinalDocument`, `fingerprint` (FNV-1a 32-bit over canonical JSON) and `verifyFinalDocument`.
- `src/domain/permissions.ts`
  - Exports `Capability` and `can()`.
- `src/domain/testkit.ts`
  - Test-only helpers: `fillAllRequired`, `toReview`, `completeAllTracks`, `toCompleted`.
- `src/store/persist.ts`
  - Exports `loadState`, `saveState` and the `?reset` handling.
- `StoreProvider({ initial, storageKey, persist })`.
- `AppStoreApi extends StoreApi`
  - Holds the new internal-only methods.
  - The live portal store (`LiveSupplierStore.tsx:265`) keeps implementing the unchanged `StoreApi`. Its only edit is adding `mail: []` to its state.

## 2. Type deltas
- The fields new on shared types are optional, so the portal's `map.ts` literals keep compiling.
```ts
// types.ts
type InternalPersonaId = 'rmm'|'reg'|'saf'|'qm'|'mic'|'sus'|'cus'|'leg'|'admin'|'auditor'|'owner';
type PersonaId = InternalPersonaId | 'supplier' | 'supplier2' | `sup:${string}`;
interface User { /* … */ active?: boolean; mayConfirm?: boolean; createdAt?: string; createdBy?: string }
interface Supplier { /* … */ city?: string; active?: boolean; vendorNo?: string; createdAt?: string; createdBy?: string; history?: SupplierEvent[] }
interface OpenPoint { /* … */ history?: OpenPointChange[]; closedBy?: string; closedAt?: string; updatedAt?: string }
type MessageAction = 'raised'|'answered'|'returned'|'accepted'|'cannot-provide'|'note'|'edited'|'withdrawn';
interface CiqCase { /* … */ finalDocument?: FinalDocument }
interface AppState { /* … */ mail: Mail[] }
```

## 3. Demo start, exactly
- **Internal users:** 11, one per persona:
  - u-rmm Katrin Vogel, u-reg Dr. Jonas Albrecht, u-saf Dr. Mira Hansen, u-qm Lena Krause, u-mic Tobias Keller, u-sus Sophie Wagner;
  - u-cus Felix Schulz, u-leg Dr. Anna Becker, u-admin Nina Hoffmann, u-auditor Paul Neumann, u-owner Dr. Claudia Richter.
- **Supplier:** 1. s1 Solvaro Oleochemicals S.A., DUNS 471203958, Tarragona, Spain, manufacturer.
- **Supplier contacts:** 2.
  - u-sup-1 Elena Márquez, Regulatory Manager.
  - u-sup-2 Ravi Menon, QA Specialist.
  - Both are active and may confirm.
- **Empty:** 0 cases, 0 mails.
- **Configuration:** templates v1 (published) and v2 (draft), rule set RS-2026.1, section ownership, reminders.
- **Persona:** rmm.
- **Why no second internal team members:** each review then lands with the person Thomas switches to. In assigneeFor, the round-robin over a one-person team always returns the persona holder.

## 4. Mail flow in the demo (expected inbox counts after the P02 walkthrough)
- **Elena and Ravi each receive:**
  - case-invited;
  - every op-raised, op-returned, op-edited and op-closed;
  - one release-requested;
  - release-receipt.
- **Each reviewer receives:**
  - review-assigned;
  - op-answered for its own points.
- **Katrin (RMM) receives:**
  - review-assigned (her own RMM review);
  - case-completed, which links to `/cases/CIQ-2026-0101/document`.

The harness asserts these exact counts from the stored state.

## 5. Final-app traceability
- **Mail channels:** each mail's `channel` names the final-app mechanism.
  - `open-point-webhook`: the generic R-1 integration, used in both the portal and the app.
  - `task-notification`: native Kissflow and portal task e-mails (X1, X5).
  - `final-document`: the AS-12 release webhook plus external script, which also e-mails RMM.
- **Point changes:** the raiser's edits and closes write `history` rows. These correspond to the API update the portal must receive (AS-08).
- **Final document:** `FinalDocument` is the content contract for the external PDF script.
  - The PDF is fixed and immutable, with a fingerprint.
  - No review version in the file name: BRM v2 removed it.

## 6. Implementation order for P3 (domain)
1. Schema, seed split and persist, with the existing tests moved to the scenario fixtures (they must stay green).
2. Personas and suppliers.
3. Guards: freeze, state and permission (fixes the O-03 and F-03 bugs).
4. Open-point edit and close.
5. Mail.
6. Final document.
7. Testkit and the new suites.
8. `prototype-fixtures.ts`.
9. Harness skeleton with P00 and P10. The screen agents add their testids while the harness grows P01–P11.

## 7. Open points to confirm with Thomas (defaults are already applied in this design)
- **Who may edit suppliers:** RMM only, with Admin as view-only, following app-plan-v4:208. The alternative is giving Admin edit rights as well.
- **Duplicate contact e-mail across suppliers:** blocked in the prototype. The final app allows one row per supplier.
- **Who sees which cases:** a supplier contact sees only the cases it is named on.
- **What the final document leaves out:** RMES decisions and internal notes. The not-accepted note is included, flagged as internal, because the document is internal to RMM.
- **Supplier copy of the PDF:** suppliers get no PDF, only a release receipt.
- **Editing an answered point:** changing the question of a point the supplier has already answered sends it back to the supplier as a new round. Changing only the due date or the justification does not.
